svg.text: trash: gone, back to start. No confirm, it's a 5 second memo.
tap to record again: the next thought is one tap away
A tap fires by accident in a pocket
or a sleeve. Holding means you
meant it, and letting go saves.
Live bars and a timer, nothing else.
You glance once and keep talking.
No stop button to hunt for.
Play, Trash, Send, big enough to hit
on a 45mm screen. Send is the only
thing in yellow, so it's the default.
A yellow check, then it gets out of
the way. The watch never shows a
Transcribed on device, waiting in the
inbox. The wrist captures, the phone
is where you sort and reread.
press and hold to start, let go to save
